name: jev-hooks
description: Commit reviewer and per-turn effort router with typed questions (Jev or rizzo-flow): commit hook, jev-review CLI and a function hook

review_url.title: Reviewer URL
review_url.description: Base URL of the /v1/systemone backend (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8017). Empty: reviewer off

router_url.title: Router URL
router_url.description: Base URL of the /v1/systemone backend for the effort router (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8019). Empty: uses review_url

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Bearer for the backend (TypeSafe, or rizzo with RIZZO_API_KEY)

router_api_key.title: Router API key
router_api_key.description: Bearer for router_url. Empty: api_key or the key file, only when router_url is on review_url's host

model.title: Model
model.description: jev-latest also works with rizzo-flow; clm-latest for CLM

commit_review.title: Review before commit
commit_review.description: Reviews the diff when Claude runs git commit

effort_router.title: Effort router
effort_router.description: Opt-in. Lowers the per-turn effort from what your prompt asks. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1, Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1 or Sonnet 5.5 and the per-turn-control beta on the account: without the beta every effort change clears the prompt cache

agent_router.title: Subagent router
agent_router.description: Opt-in. Before a subagent starts, asks the backend what kind of task it was given: one that checks a stated claim or labels items against a written definition runs on Claude Haiku 5.5. Never touches a subagent whose model was chosen, a fork or a teammate. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 and Claude Code 2.1.294 or later

status_line.title: Status line
status_line.description: One line under the prompt: the jev-hooks version this session runs, a newer one installed (then /reload-plugins), and the outcome of the last commit review. Reads only the plugin's folder and its review log. Needs function hooks (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1)
